evidence: Agent isolation is supported by both source and the existing measured image probe. In the frozen task, environment/Dockerfile:9-15 installs only Express/better-sqlite3 and copies only public instructions/assets; lines 17-23 initialize an empty /app. The copied public files contain product rules and seed records, without private criterion blocks, scoring policy or judge instructions. task.toml:2 transfers /app and /assets, and :26-35 selects a separate verifier and places provider variables only in verifier.env. tests/Dockerfile:16-31 installs judge clients/RewardKit in the verifier, :43-44 copies /tests and removes group/other access. tests/test.sh:3,10-12 uses umask 077 and protects verifier logs and tests; :72-83 rejects escaping submission symlinks; :104-111 and :160-167 run the submission as UID/GID 65534 with a sanitized env. RewardKit and score.py run from /tests at :203-227, with outputs under the protected log directory; score.py:10 reads its policy from /tests/scoring.toml. These four shared boundary files are byte-identical to the frozen template. Existing local/agent-boundary.json records exit 0 and observed app=[.git,.gitkeep], testsExists=false, solutionExists=false, globalModules=[better-sqlite3,corepack,express,npm]. Its SHA256 def50623c81484935aec3e0de70149ecbe03e0693f8dec1a40387f416ef71f13 matches the raw index; all nine cited task inputs match both that entry and the frozen manifest, and cited workbook/skill/references/template files match manifest hashes. This establishes the assigned image/source isolation check, not a full judge completion, Oracle or model score. Verifier adversarial runtime probing was not executed in this read-only review.
counterexample: Considered a broken app that tries to read /tests/scored/functional/judge.toml or replace /logs/verifier/reward.txt to earn credit without behavior: the private image separation and verifier UID/parent-directory permissions prevent those paths, while symlinks escaping /app/node_modules are rejected. This is source reasoning, not a newly executed attack. A conforming app that uses the public seed/business rules and ordinary files under /app remains readable/writable as UID 65534 through test.sh:85-102; it does not need grader access, and permitted Node dependencies remain available via NODE_PATH. No row-46 false pass/fail counterexample was established.
